PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (17.0, 12.0, 22.0),     # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # input pair L (flicker noise, gain)
    "gmid3": (11.0, 7.0, 14.0),      # PMOS mirror load gm/Id
    "L3":    (0.7, 0.4, 1.2),        # PMOS mirror L (gain vs mirror pole)
    "gmidt": (13.0, 9.0, 16.0),      # tail / bias mirror gm/Id
    "Lt":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # tail / bias L
    "itail": (70e-6, 45e-6, 80e-6),  # tail current
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    it = p["itail"]
    i1 = it / 2.0

    # bias: diode-connected nfet sinks IREF; tail mirrors it (same L, gm/Id)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], iref, vds=0.65)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], it, vds=0.3)

    # input pair
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], i1, vds=0.4)

    # PMOS mirror load
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], i1, vds=0.9)
    m4 = m3

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # vinp device on the diode side -> non-inverting to vout
    n.dev("M1", "nd", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "nd", "nd", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "nd", "vdd", "vdd", m4)

    # predictions
    gm1 = m1.gm
    gout = m1.gds + m4.gds
    a0 = gm1 / gout
    cout = cl + m1.cdd + m4.cdd + m4.cgd
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cout)
    cmir = 2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    fp2 = m3.gm / (2 * PI * cmir)
    # mirror pole-zero doublet (zero at 2*fp2) softens the phase loss
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fp2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / (2 * fp2)))
    power = vdd * (it + iref)
    slew = it / cout
    # output swing limits: low = Vsource + vdsat2, high = VDD - vdsat4
    vs = vcm - m1.vgs
    swing = (vdd - m4.vdsat - 0.05) - (vs + m1.vdsat + 0.05)
    # CMRR ~ 2*gm3*Rtail*A0-ish (first order: gm1*(2/gdst)*gm3/... ), use simple form
    cmrr = db(2 * m3.gm / mt.gds * a0 / max(a0, 1) * (m1.gm / (m1.gm + 1e-12)))
    psrr = db(a0) - 3
    # thermal noise only (flicker handled by large input area)
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    sv_th = 2 * (8 * kT / (3 * gm1)) * (1 + m3.gm / gm1)
    noise = math.sqrt(sv_th) * 6.0   # crude flicker factor at 1 kHz
    tau = 1 / (2 * PI * ugbw)
    settle = 0.4 / slew + 4.6 * tau

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(a0), "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
        "slew": slew, "swing": swing, "cmrr_db": cmrr, "psrr_db": psrr,
        "noise_1k": noise, "settle": settle,
    }
